scripts.title: Hajun yk its gonna easy
scripts.features:
Mini-HUD (Bottom-right control panel)
 TP to Closest Fuse Button (Instantly teleports you to the nearest fuse)
 TP to Fuse Room Button (Instantly teleports you to the breaker room)
 Auto-Warp & AI Message Trigger (Automatically teleports you to the breaker room and displays "dw twin I got you / interact with it" once 4 fuses are collected)
 Live Telemetry & Intel Panel (Displays your real-time Health, WalkSpeed, 3D Coordinates, player count, active fuses, tracked monsters, nearest threat distance, and nearest fuse distance)
 Player & Entity ESP (Glowing highlights and wallhack lines for players and monsters)
 Fuse ESP & Beams (Glowing outlines and tracking beams pointing directly to interactive fuses)
 Monster Proximity Threat Alerts (On-screen danger pop-ups when a monster gets close)
 Fuse Proximity Notifications (On-screen alerts when a fuse is right next to you)
 Interactive AI Assistant Popup (An on-screen floating text box that greets you, moves to the corner, and updates with live status messages like monster warnings)
